title: Term Renewal, Graduation and Senior Plan Moves
content:
Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans renew automatically. Where automatic renewal applies, the plan renews at the term end into a new term with the plan's renewal enrollment fee. A juvenile plan renews into its graduation plan, and an adult plan renews into the senior plan of the species once the pet's age on the renewal date has reached the plan's senior age. Counts of included services restart with the new term. A customer who opts out before the term end lets the plan expire with no settlement.

## Renewal terms by plan

| Plan | Renews automatically | Renewal enrollment fee | Graduation plan (the plan a juvenile plan renews into when the pet has aged out) | Senior age (age at which a renewal moves to the senior plan of the species) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | Yes | 0.00 USD | Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 0 — not applicable |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | Yes | 0.00 USD | Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 0 — not applicable |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | Yes | 0.00 USD | none | 7 years |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | Yes | 0.00 USD | none | 10 years |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | Yes | 0.00 USD | none | 0 — not applicable |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | Yes | 0.00 USD | none | 0 — not applicable |

## Plan for the new term — hypothetical pets at renewal

| Plan ending | Pet's age on the renewal date | Plan for the new term |
|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | aged out of the juvenile plan | Adult Dog Wellness Plan |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | aged out of the juvenile plan | Adult Cat Wellness Plan |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 6 years and some months | Adult Dog Wellness Plan |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | exactly 7 years | Senior Dog Wellness Plan |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 9 years and some months | Adult Cat Wellness Plan |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 10 years or more | Senior Cat Wellness Plan |
| Senior Dog or Senior Cat Wellness Plan | any | the same senior plan |

"Has reached" includes the senior age itself: a dog aged exactly 7 years on the renewal date has reached 7 years.

## What renewal changes

- A new term begins, with a new start and end; the renewal enrollment fee is 0.00 under every plan.
- Plan fees paid and the list value of services used start again from 0.00 for the new term, and the counts of included services restart.
- The age that decides a move to a senior plan is the pet's age on the renewal date.

## Opting out

A customer who opts out before the term end lets the plan expire at the term end. An expiry carries no settlement: nothing is owed and nothing is refunded on account of the expiry.
